findings.finding: Official county/state records support a deterministic 22-jurisdiction Rensselaer municipality universe: two cities, fourteen towns, and six distinct villages after assessment-row deduplication.
The baseline directly fills #1894's official locality-recursion prerequisite but leaves operator and ALPR layers intentionally unresolved.
